caseName: Ehrlich v. City of Culver City
caseNameFull: Ehrlich v. City of Culver City

opinions.text:
Ct. App. Cal., 2d App. Dist. Motion of Pacific Legal Foundation for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of Dolan v. City of Tigard, ante, p. 374.

Justice Blackmun, Justice Stevens, Justice Souter, and Justice Ginsburg would deny certiorari.
